_comment: TECH v0.9.1 extended shops (Master Design Bible v1.0 s19, D-18). XShopProp ids $80+, 8 entries, 9-bit item ids; vanilla shops $00-$7F byte-exact. No ultimate gear; vanilla prices.

shops.note: Rebuilt Mobliz: Iron Ration, Remedy, Fenix Down (Phoenix Down), Gaia Tonic, Gaia Gear
Reopened Narshe Forge: Flame Sabre, Blizzard, ThunderBlade (elemental blades) + Gold Shld, Diamond Shld. Tempered Edge is NOT sold (D-20: Empty Forge reward only)
derived: shield choice (Gold / Diamond: practical mid-late shields, no Crystal / Aegis / Genji)

shops.note: Rebuilt Doma: Forged, Tempest, Murasame (Cyan katanas), Ninja Gear, Head Band (ashigaru-style existing gear) + Fire Skean, Water Edge, Bolt Edge (scrolls). No Doma Edge (D-20)
derived: gear choice for 'Ashigaru-style existing gear' (no Masamune / Strato / Sky Render)

shops.note: Figaro Foundry before EXP_CELES_DONE: the canonical tools (vanilla shop $54 contents, type and price modifier 6 = half price for Edgar)
Figaro Foundry once EXP_CELES_DONE is set: the canonical tools + limited Magitek Cell (cap 3). Technical split of the logical shop $83: the Foundry clerk event opens $84 when EXP_CELES_DONE is set
derived: technical shop id $84 (the vanilla shop command has no per-entry condition)
